DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.label: spirit gathering altar
DreamsOutposts.OutpostFacilityDef.description: A stone altar raised over a spirit vein node. Cultivators sit here in meditation, condensing the qi of heaven and earth into solid form. It has a base daily output of 5 spiritual crystals or 1.2 liquid jade, and its output can be switched between the two at any time.\n\nBase efficiency is 0.5: each colonist stationed at the outpost who has a spirit root adds 1 efficiency, and each cultivation rank above Catkins adds another 1.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostTypeDef.label: immortal gate outpost
DreamsOutposts.OutpostTypeDef.description: A gate of the immortal path built on a remote node of flowing qi. Cultivators stationed here gather spiritual crystal or liquid jade from the land itself.
